plugins.name: Brew
plugins.description: Search, inspect, upgrade and uninstall Homebrew formulae & casks (macOS). Uses Qx context.cli.

descriptions.en: Search, inspect, upgrade and uninstall Homebrew formulae and casks on macOS.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在 macOS 上搜索、查看、更新和卸载 Homebrew formula 与 cask。

plugins.author: qx (ported from Raycast brew by nhojb et al.)

notes_localizations.en: Moved package refresh and upgrade operations into the panel and removed duplicate searchable commands.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将软件包刷新与升级操作统一到面板，并移除重复的可搜索命令。

notes_localizations.en: Improved Homebrew package browsing, outdated-item detection, and safe upgrade actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进 Homebrew 软件包浏览、过期版本识别与安全升级操作。

plugins.name: Clipboard Actions
plugins.description: Paste clipboard text as plain text or save the current clipboard image without overwriting existing files.

descriptions.en: Paste clipboard text as plain text or save the current clipboard image without overwriting existing files.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将剪贴板文字以纯文本粘贴，或将当前剪贴板图片保存为不会覆盖旧文件的新 PNG。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Added opt-in no-view commands to paste clipboard text as plain text and save clipboard images as unique offline PNG files.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增可选的无界面命令：将剪贴板文字以纯文本粘贴，并把剪贴板图片离线保存为不覆盖的唯一 PNG 文件。

plugins.name: External Display Control
plugins.description: Adjust built-in and external display brightness through Qx's native macOS and Windows display service.

descriptions.en: Adjust built-in and external display brightness through Qx's native display service.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 Qx 原生显示器服务调节内置和外接显示器亮度。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; open the display controls through the plugin panel.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，显示器控制改由插件面板入口打开。

notes_localizations.en: Enables the Display Brightness panel and tray/home providers on Windows (manifest platforms previously listed macOS only).
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 在 Windows 上启用显示器亮度面板与托盘/主页提供器（此前 manifest 的 platforms 仅声明了 macOS）。

notes_localizations.en: Bounds open-displays brightness probe so DDC delays cannot stall the command, and relies on the host panel for full enumeration.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 为 open-displays 亮度探测增加超时，避免 DDC 延迟卡住命令；完整枚举改由宿主面板负责。

notes_localizations.en: Ramps hardware brightness toward the latest drag target in small steps to avoid visible flashes during adjustment.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 拖拽调节时以小步平滑过渡到最新目标亮度，避免显示器硬件亮度跳变闪屏。

notes_localizations.en: Adds host-rendered lightweight Tray and Home brightness providers without keeping the full plugin panel runtime active.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增宿主绘制的轻量 Tray 与主页亮度数据提供器，无需常驻完整插件面板运行时。

notes_localizations.en: Keeps slider dragging continuous across direction changes and WebView pointer-capture cancellation without snapping or losing the thumb.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复滑块反向拖动和 WebView 指针捕获取消时跳变、丢失拖拽点的问题，拖拽过程保持连续。

notes_localizations.en: Keeps display values synchronized with silent incremental polling, removes the in-panel refresh toolbar, and publishes manual refresh through host Actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 通过静默增量轮询持续同步显示器状态，移除面板内刷新工具栏，并将手动刷新发布到宿主 Actions。

notes_localizations.en: Rebuilt the glow as a layered effect: a capsule fill, a masked tail only between current and previous values, and a soft endpoint bloom.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将微光重构为分层效果：胶囊填充、仅位于新旧数值之间的渐隐尾迹，以及柔和的端点光斑。

notes_localizations.en: Rounded the fill and fading trail into capsule ends, with a soft elliptical glow at the previous brightness position.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将填充和消散残影改为胶囊圆端，并在原亮度位置增加柔和的椭圆光晕。

notes_localizations.en: Extended firefly particles beyond the progress track so they float along its upper and lower edges while following brightness.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将萤火虫粒子延伸到进度条外侧，使其沿上下边缘漂浮并跟随亮度进度。

notes_localizations.en: Added pointer-captured, frame-following slider drag with throttled latest-value hardware writes.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增指针捕获的跟手拖拽，并以节流的最新值队列写入硬件。

notes_localizations.en: Updates brightness values immediately after adjustment, rolls back failed writes, and reconciles delayed DDC readback in the background.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 调节后立即更新亮度数值，写入失败自动回滚，并在后台校准延迟的 DDC 回读。

notes_localizations.en: Added a luminous firefly-style brightness track with trailing glow when brightness is reduced.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增萤火虫点状发光亮度条，降低亮度时保留并淡出右侧荧光残影。

notes_localizations.en: Preserved raw DDC brightness values and surfaced discovery/read/write diagnostics; added a safe single-external-display IOAVService fallback.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 保留 DDC 原始亮度值并显示发现、读写诊断；单外接屏场景增加安全的 IOAVService fallback。

notes_localizations.en: Moved display brightness into Qx native macOS capability; the plugin now controls built-in and DDC/CI displays without external CLIs.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将显示器亮度下沉到 Qx 原生 macOS 能力层；插件现在无需外部命令行工具即可控制内置屏和支持 DDC/CI 的外接屏。

notes_localizations.en: Refined external-display discovery and DDC/CI brightness controls.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 优化外接显示器发现与 DDC/CI 亮度控制。

plugins.name: Hacker News
plugins.description: Browse the latest Hacker News stories with details and comments.

descriptions.en: Browse the latest Hacker News stories with details and comments.
descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览 Hacker News 最新帖子、正文与评论。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; story actions remain available in the Workbench.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，帖子操作继续保留在 Workbench 中。

notes_localizations.en: Initial Hacker News Workbench panel with latest stories, lazy nested comments, and stale-while-revalidate caching.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个 Hacker News Workbench 面板：支持最新帖子、按需嵌套评论与 stale-while-revalidate 缓存。

plugins.name: Pomodoro Island
plugins.description: Reference plugin for declarative Workbench and the structured QxIsland session protocol, with persistent background timing and history.

descriptions.zh-CN: 带休息提醒的专注计时器。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Island shows Pause/Resume and Stop together; idle background heartbeats no longer re-dismiss the island every five seconds.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 灵动岛同时提供暂停/继续与停止；空闲心跳不再每五秒重复 dismiss 灵动岛。

notes_localizations.en: Improved persistent Pomodoro sessions, history, and QxIsland controls.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进番茄钟持久会话、历史记录与 QxIsland 控制。

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; the calendar view is now opened through the plugin panel.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，日历视图改由插件面板入口打开。

notes_localizations.en: Updated the calendar view and Qx compatibility packaging.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 更新日历视图与 Qx 兼容打包。

plugins.name: Qx Bing Wallpaper
plugins.description: Browse Bing's daily images in a native Qx thumbnail list, then download or set them as wallpaper.

descriptions.en: Browse Bing's daily images, download them, or set them as wallpaper.
descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览必应每日图片，下载图片或将其设为壁纸。

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate gallery-opening command while retaining real wallpaper and background operations.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的图库打开命令，同时保留真实的壁纸与后台操作。

notes_localizations.en: Changed wallpaper browsing to a Workbench thumbnail list so the left column stays readable when the full-size detail is open.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将壁纸浏览改为 Workbench 缩略图列表，打开大图详情时左侧列表不再挤压堆叠。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed daily wallpaper recovery after sleep or restart, replaced competing schedules with one configurable daily job, and report real failures instead of false success.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复休眠或重启后的每日壁纸补执行，合并为一个可配置的每日任务，并让真实失败不再显示为成功。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the native Workbench Gallery for daily-image browsing, downloads, and wallpaper actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入原生 Workbench Gallery，统一每日图片浏览、下载与壁纸操作。

plugins.name: QxCoolapk 酷安
plugins.description: Browse Coolapk hot, news, and digital feeds and read complete posts, images, and replies in Qx.

descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览酷安社区热门、快讯与数码内容，并在 Qx 内阅读完整正文、图片和回复。
descriptions.en: Browse Coolapk community feeds and read complete posts, images, and replies in Qx.

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate launcher command and only show Mark Unread for posts already marked read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的启动命令，并仅对已读帖子显示“标为未读”操作。

notes_localizations.en: Adds an explicit Refresh Anonymous Device action that persists a replacement identity and refreshes the feed without clearing content cache; repeated rotation is discouraged to avoid worsening Coolapk risk control.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增“刷新匿名设备标识”手动操作：持久化新的匿名身份并刷新信息流，不清空内容缓存；提示不要连续轮换，以免加重酷安风控。

notes_localizations.en: Stops all installations from sharing one Coolapk device identity by persisting a stable anonymous per-installation device code and deriving fresh request tokens from it; explains the account-limit response without retry storms.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复所有安装共用同一个酷安设备身份的问题：为每个安装持久化稳定的匿名设备标识，并据此生成动态请求 token；遇到设备关联账号过多时给出明确提示，避免连续重试触发风控。

notes_localizations.en: Preserves every source detail image with four-request bounded concurrency and prefetches nearby text and replies for offline reopen.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 完整保留原帖全部详情图片，以四路有界并发加载，并预取相邻正文与回复供离线重开。

notes_localizations.en: Removed duplicate inline article and image loading indicators; loading now stays in the host Island.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除详情内重复的正文与图片加载提示，加载状态统一保留在宿主灵动岛。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the Qx state SDK for read history, latest-only cache writes, bounded image previews, and stale-request cancellation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入 Qx 状态 SDK，统一已读历史、只写最新缓存快照、有界图片预览与过期请求失效。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed read state surviving panel reopen and feed changes with serialized writes and bounded retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复已读状态在面板重开和信息流变化后丢失的问题，并采用串行写入与有界保留。

notes_localizations.en: Simplified post badges by keeping read state color-only while retaining image, like, and reply metrics.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简帖子标记：已读状态仅保留蓝色与灰色区分，继续显示图片、点赞和回复数据。

notes_localizations.en: Moves Coolapk replies to the host Workbench reply surface with stable #floor, author, time, and OP metadata while retaining the host-owned dynamic image filmstrip.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 酷安回复接入宿主 Workbench 通用回复区，统一显示 #楼号、作者、时间和楼主标记；动态多图继续使用宿主胶片与大图预览。

notes_localizations.en: Compacts article metadata into the author and time line and removes the duplicated full-width property table below the body.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将点赞、回复、阅读和设备压缩到作者与时间同一行，删除正文下方重复占位的属性大表格。

notes_localizations.en: Restores long-form Coolapk articles from their ordered source blocks so each protected image appears at its original position between paragraphs.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 按酷安原始长文块恢复正文顺序，受保护图片会回到对应段落之间的原始位置，不再统一堆在文末。

notes_localizations.en: Improves full-image clarity by retaining safe original-resolution media and prepares oversized images with a higher-resolution, long-screenshot-aware fallback.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 提升大图清晰度：安全范围内保留原始分辨率，超大图片使用更高分辨率且识别超长截图的回退处理。

notes_localizations.en: Stabilizes the feed with one cover thumbnail per dynamic post, keeps every original image in the detail filmstrip with the API count, and shows original-content and original-image loading in the island.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 主列表改为每条动态只显示一张封面缩略图；详情胶片按酷安原始数量展示全部图片，并在灵动岛分别显示原始正文与原始图片加载状态。

notes_localizations.en: Adds original-article loading activity in the island, read/unread filters and bulk management, read cleanup, cache garbage cleanup, and configurable read-first memory retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增灵动岛原文加载动画、已读/未读筛选与批量管理、已读清理、缓存垃圾清理，以及可配置的已读优先内存保留策略。

notes_localizations.en: Dynamic-post cards now load every image returned by Coolapk instead of truncating the card gallery.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 动态卡片现在加载酷安返回的全部图片，不再截断卡片图集。

notes_localizations.en: Distinguishes Coolapk articles from social posts: article images follow the reading body, while dynamic-post images appear as compact list cards.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 区分酷安图文与动态：文章图片跟随正文阅读，动态图片改为紧凑的信息流卡片。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed Coolapk image HTTP 567 failures with authenticated media fetching, background thumbnails, and bounded large-image/GIF previews.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复酷安图片 HTTP 567：改用鉴权媒体请求，并新增后台缩略图及受控的大图/GIF 预览。

notes_localizations.en: Initial QxCoolapk release with hot/news/digital feeds, complete article reading, multi-image details, replies, read state, and offline cache.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: QxCoolapk 首发：支持热门、快讯与数码信息流，完整正文阅读、多图详情、回复、已读状态和离线缓存。

plugins.name: QxGH
plugins.description: QxGH — watch GitHub Actions and Releases from public github.com pages (no REST API). Business-only workbench UI.

descriptions.en: Monitor Actions runs and Releases for public GitHub repositories, with build status, estimated progress, and Island updates.
descriptions.zh-CN: 监控公开 GitHub 仓库的 Actions 运行与 Releases，并显示构建状态、预计进度和灵动岛提醒。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command while retaining refresh, status, and Island operations.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，同时保留刷新、状态与灵动岛操作。

notes_localizations.en: Mark Open Run/Release on GitHub as primary so Enter runs the open action in detail view.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将「在 GitHub 打开运行/发布」标为 primary，详情态回车可打开链接。

notes_localizations.en: Added complete English and Simplified Chinese plugin descriptions for the host-rendered Context About section.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 为宿主固定渲染的 Context“关于”区补齐英文与简体中文插件描述。

notes_localizations.en: Added the localized Simplified Chinese plugin name Github助手 across Qx plugin surfaces.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将插件简体中文名称统一为“Github助手”，并同步到 Qx 的插件入口与面板。

notes_localizations.en: Made every Workbench action executable and keyboard-addressable, removed duplicate Enter semantics, and hid the Island toggle when no active run exists.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 让每个 Workbench 操作都可真实执行并支持菜单字母键，移除重复的 Enter 语义，并在没有活动运行时隐藏灵动岛开关。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed long cold loads behind a system proxy by fetching repository indexes concurrently and moving run-duration enrichment behind the first usable list.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复系统代理下冷启动长时间卡在加载状态：仓库索引改为并发请求，运行耗时在首批可用列表之后后台补齐。

notes_localizations.en: Added a native tray deployment submenu with estimated progress, elapsed/expected time, refresh, and CI summary actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增原生托盘部署子菜单：显示预计进度、已用/预计时间，并提供刷新和 CI 摘要操作。

notes_localizations.en: Added history-based estimated workflow progress, live elapsed-time updates, and non-destructive refresh behavior.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增基于历史耗时的工作流预计进度、实时用时更新，并让刷新过程保留已有列表。

notes_localizations.en: Improved public GitHub Actions and Releases parsing with clearer Workbench status.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进公开 GitHub Actions 与 Releases 解析及 Workbench 状态展示。

plugins.name: QxGold
plugins.description: Live JD accumulated-gold quotes with locally sampled history.

descriptions.zh-CN: 京东积存金实时价格与本地真实采样曲线。
descriptions.en: Live JD accumulated-gold quotes with locally sampled history.

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; price tracking remains in the plugin panel.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，金价追踪继续通过插件面板提供。

notes_localizations.en: Replaced the embedded SVG with a host-rendered, theme-aware line chart and clarified that history contains only real locally sampled quotes.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将内嵌 SVG 曲线改为宿主主题化结构化曲线，并明确历史数据仅包含本地采集的真实报价样本。

notes_localizations.en: Added an opt-in Qx Island price display with localized settings and slot release when disabled.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增可选的 Qx 灵动岛金价显示、双语设置，并在关闭时释放灵动岛信息位。

notes_localizations.en: Initial QX Gold release with live JD accumulated-gold pricing, cached samples, and a Workbench line chart.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个 QX Gold 版本：接入京东积存金实时价格、历史采样缓存与 Workbench 金价曲线。

plugins.name: QxHeihe 小黑盒
plugins.description: 浏览小黑盒社区推荐内容，在 Qx 内查看正文、多图、帖子信息与匿名优先评论。

descriptions.en: Browse Heybox community recommendations and read posts and comments in Qx.
descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览小黑盒社区推荐内容，在 Qx 内查看正文、多图、帖子信息与匿名优先评论。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed duplicate panel and comments-opening actions; only show Mark Unread for posts already marked read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板与评论打开操作，并仅对已读帖子显示“标为未读”。

notes_localizations.en: Prefetches the nearest post details and comments into persistent cache without marking them read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 低优先级预取相邻正文与评论并写入持久缓存，且不会误标为已读。

notes_localizations.en: Moved post and comment loading out of detail content and into the host Island animation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将正文与评论加载状态移出详情内容，统一使用宿主灵动岛动画。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the Qx state SDK for bounded read history, latest-only cache writes, and stale-request cancellation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入 Qx 状态 SDK，统一有界已读历史、只写最新缓存快照与过期请求失效。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed read state surviving panel reopen, refresh, and pagination with serialized writes and bounded retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复已读状态在面板重开、刷新和翻页后丢失的问题，并采用串行写入与有界保留。

notes_localizations.en: Restored the signed anonymous comment-tree transport and repackaged the marketplace archive without replacing the existing 1.4.6 artifact in place.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 恢复带签名的匿名评论树传输，并以新版本重新打包市场归档，避免原地替换已有 1.4.6 安装包。

notes_localizations.en: Aligned anonymous comment-tree requests with the browser post origin and web Referer instead of API share redirects.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将匿名评论树请求改为使用浏览器帖子 Origin 和网页 Referer，避免复用 API 分享跳转地址。

notes_localizations.en: Invalidated older detail caches after the anonymous comment-tree transport change so installed updates retry comments instead of reusing a resolved empty result.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 匿名评论树传输变更后升级详情缓存版本，确保安装更新会重新拉取评论，而不是继续复用已解析但为空的旧结果。

notes_localizations.en: Handled upstream CAPTCHA/risk-control responses explicitly, preserving cached comments and providing a localized verification prompt without repeated retries.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 明确处理上游 CAPTCHA/风控响应，保留缓存评论并显示双语验证提示，避免重复重试。

notes_localizations.en: Switched comment loading to the signed public comment tree endpoint, enabling anonymous first-page comments with nested replies.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 切换到带签名的公开评论树接口，支持匿名读取首屏评论及楼中楼回复。

notes_localizations.en: Moved author, community, publication time, like, and comment metadata into the Workbench detail header.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将作者、社区、发布时间、点赞和评论信息移动到 Workbench 详情作者信息行，移除正文下方重复属性表。

notes_localizations.en: Simplified list badges by expressing read state through accent and neutral colors without redundant Read or Unread text.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简列表标记：已读状态仅通过蓝色与灰色区分，不再重复显示“已读/未读”文字。

notes_localizations.en: Added configurable horizontal or grid multi-image details, host-native keyboard gallery navigation, and preserved article paragraphs.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增可配置的横向胶片或网格多图详情、宿主原生键盘大图切换，并修复正文段落合并问题。

notes_localizations.en: Replaced expiring captured feed URLs with live Xiaoheihe request signing for open, refresh, and pagination.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 使用小黑盒实时请求签名替代会过期的抓包 URL，覆盖首次加载、刷新与分页。

notes_localizations.en: Changed the optional comment Cookie to plain text and added the article share URL as the full-detail request source.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 评论 Cookie 改为普通文本输入，并以文章分享链接作为完整详情请求来源。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed first-selection detail loading and added optional authenticated comments with cached offline rendering.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复首次选中不加载详情，并新增可选登录评论区及评论离线缓存展示。

notes_localizations.en: Added instant reopen from cache, offline reading, read state, and automatic 3/7-day cleanup.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增缓存秒开、离线阅读、已读状态及 3/7 天自动清理。

notes_localizations.en: Initial Xiaoheihe community release with feed browsing and structured post details.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个小黑盒社区版本，支持信息流浏览与结构化帖子详情。

plugins.name: Qxpicture
plugins.description: Browse random image APIs, save images, copy them, and set desktop wallpaper.

descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览随机图片 API，保存或复制图片，并设置桌面壁纸。
descriptions.en: Browse random image APIs, save images, copy them, and set desktop wallpaper.

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; image management remains available through the panel actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，图片管理继续通过面板操作提供。

notes_localizations.en: Added a Refresh All API Images action and a bounded first-open cache warm-up when no image previews are stored.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增“刷新全部 API 壁纸”操作，并在没有图片缓存的首次打开时以受控并发批量预热。

notes_localizations.en: Rebuilt API creation as an inline validated Workbench draft with atomic persistence and reliable form focus.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将 API 新增流程重构为 Workbench 内联校验草稿，原子持久化并修复表单焦点。

notes_localizations.en: Added structured per-API parameter management, deletion, and batch Workbench source updates.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增结构化 API 参数管理、删除及 Workbench 数据源批量更新。

plugins.name: QxTieba 贴吧
plugins.description: 聚合浏览多个百度贴吧的公开帖子流，在 Qx 内阅读正文与楼层评论。

descriptions.en: Browse public Baidu Tieba feeds and read posts and replies in Qx.
descriptions.zh-CN: 聚合浏览多个百度贴吧的公开帖子流，在 Qx 内阅读正文与楼层评论。

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate launcher command and only show Mark Unread for posts already marked read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的启动命令，并仅对已读帖子显示“标为未读”操作。

notes_localizations.en: Renders Tieba image_emoticon markers in the main post, floor replies, and nested comments through the shared Workbench inline-content protocol.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将贴吧正文、楼层回复和楼中楼评论中的 image_emoticon 表情统一接入 Workbench 通用行内内容协议渲染。

notes_localizations.en: Prefetches the nearest thread details into persistent cache without marking them read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 低优先级预取相邻帖子详情并写入持久缓存，且不会误标为已读。

notes_localizations.en: Moved thread and comment loading out of detail content and into the host Island animation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将帖子与评论加载状态移出详情内容，统一使用宿主灵动岛动画。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the Qx state SDK for bounded read history, latest-only cache writes, and stale-request cancellation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入 Qx 状态 SDK，统一有界已读历史、只写最新缓存快照与过期请求失效。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed read state surviving panel reopen, refresh, pagination, and forum switching with serialized writes and bounded retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复已读状态在面板重开、刷新、翻页和切换贴吧后丢失的问题，并采用串行写入与有界保留。

notes_localizations.en: Renders Tieba image_emoticon markers as compact inline images from the offline plugin package, with readable fallback text for missing assets.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将评论中的 image_emoticon 表情代码渲染为插件安装包内的紧凑行内图片，资源缺失时仍保留可读文本。

notes_localizations.en: Publishes floor likes through the shared Workbench reply metadata so counts appear beside each author instead of below the reply body.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 楼层点赞数改用 Workbench 通用回复元数据发布，显示在作者右侧，不再单独占用正文下方一行。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed compressed Tieba Protobuf responses being misread as unsupported wire types, switched detail requests to HTTPS with identity encoding, and added clear verification/JSON diagnostics.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复贴吧压缩 Protobuf 被误判为不支持的 wire type；详情请求改用 HTTPS 与 identity 编码，并补充验证页和 JSON 响应的准确诊断。

notes_localizations.en: Bundled the Protobuf transport into the self-contained plugin entry so Qx's Blob runtime can register the panel without unresolved relative imports.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将 Protobuf 传输模块打包进自包含插件入口，修复 Qx Blob 运行时因无法解析相对导入而提示 Plugin not registered。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed HTTP 403 thread failures by matching astron-tieba-mcp 0.1.7's anonymous app-compatible Protobuf detail protocol, including first-page floors and nested comments.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 按照 astron-tieba-mcp 0.1.7 的游客态 app-compatible Protobuf 详情协议修复帖子 HTTP 403，并读取首屏楼层与楼中楼评论。

notes_localizations.en: Added a mixed multi-forum feed that loads configured forums concurrently, interleaves posts, and remains usable when one forum fails.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增多贴吧混合 Feed：并发加载配置贴吧、交错合并帖子，并在单个贴吧失败时继续展示其他贴吧。

notes_localizations.en: Added Tulading and Laptop as the default forums, with native tabs and comma/newline-separated multi-forum preferences.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 默认配置图拉丁吧和笔记本吧，新增原生标签切换，并支持用逗号或换行配置多个贴吧。

notes_localizations.en: Initial QxTieba release with a configurable forum feed, first-page thread comments, Workbench detail reading, pagination and offline cache.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个 QxTieba 版本：支持配置贴吧名称、吧内 Feed、首屏楼层评论、Workbench 详情阅读、分页与离线缓存。

plugins.name: QxWeibo 微博
plugins.description: Read configured Weibo users, an aggregated following feed, comments, and proxied images in Qx.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在 Qx 中阅读指定微博用户、聚合关注流、评论区和代理图片。
descriptions.en: Read configured Weibo users, an aggregated following feed, comments, and proxied images in Qx.

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate launcher command and only show Mark Unread for posts already marked read.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的启动命令，并仅对已读帖子显示“标为未读”操作。

notes_localizations.en: Mark Open on Weibo as primary so Enter opens the post from the detail surface.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将「在微博中打开」标为 primary，详情态回车可打开原帖。

notes_localizations.en: Makes Enter open a post detail and return to the list from detail, with shortcuts for every Weibo action.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 回车在帖子列表打开详情、详情中返回列表，并为全部微博操作补齐快捷键。

notes_localizations.en: Removes the detail image count limit, keeps ordered bounded-concurrent loading, and prefetches nearby post text and comments.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 取消详情图片数量截断，继续按原顺序有界并发加载，并预取相邻微博正文与评论。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed multi-image details losing earlier images, added bounded concurrent image fetching with ordered group commits, and moved loading to the host Island.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复多图详情加载后只剩一张的问题，改为有界并发获取并按原顺序整组提交，同时将加载状态统一移到宿主灵动岛。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the Qx state SDK for read history, latest-only cache writes, bounded image previews, and stale-request cancellation.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入 Qx 状态 SDK，统一已读历史、只写最新缓存快照、有界图片预览与过期请求失效。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed read state surviving panel reopen and feed switching with serialized writes and bounded retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复已读状态在面板重开和切换信息流后丢失的问题，并采用串行写入与有界保留。

notes_localizations.en: Simplified post badges by keeping read state color-only while retaining image and comment metrics.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简微博标记：已读状态仅保留蓝色与灰色区分，继续显示图片和评论数据。

notes_localizations.en: Moved Weibo comments into the shared Workbench reply surface with floor numbers, authors, timestamps, original-poster markers, and preserved reply relationships.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 微博评论接入 Workbench 通用底部回复区，统一显示楼号、作者、时间、楼主标记并保留回复关系。

notes_localizations.en: Split maintainable source code into composition, Weibo workflow, and media proxy modules while retaining a self-contained runtime entry for Qx.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将可维护源码拆分为入口组装、微博工作流与媒体代理模块，同时为 Qx 保留自包含的单文件运行入口。

notes_localizations.en: Initial read-only Weibo release with configured-user posts, a bounded aggregated following feed, comments, rotating visitor cookies, randomized request pacing, SWR cache, and session-only image proxying.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: QxWeibo 首发：支持指定用户帖子、受控聚合关注流、评论区、游客 Cookie 轮换、随机请求间隔、缓存优先及仅会话保存的微博图片代理。

plugins.name: Sysinfo
plugins.description: Native Qx System Monitor for CPU, memory, power, storage, displays, network, and processes on macOS and Windows.

descriptions.en: Lightweight native hardware monitor for CPU, memory, power, storage, displays, network, and processes.
descriptions.zh-CN: 轻量原生硬件监视器：查看 CPU、内存、电源、存储、显示器、网络与进程信息。

plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate launcher command; system information is opened through the plugin panel.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的启动命令，系统信息改由插件面板入口打开。

notes_localizations.en: Added a localized display inventory with resolution, refresh rate, scaling, rotation, connection technology and available EDID identifiers, plus recognizable hardware category icons.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增汉化显示器清单，展示分辨率、刷新率、缩放、旋转、连接协议及可用的 EDID 标识，并为硬件分类补充易识别图标。

notes_localizations.en: Prevented overlapping monitor refreshes and adopted Qx's direct Win32 system and battery sampling path.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 避免系统监视刷新重叠，并接入 Qx 的原生 Win32 系统与电池采样路径。

notes_localizations.en: Connected CPU, memory, power, and network to Qx's host-rendered Home components.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将 CPU、内存、电量和网络接入 Qx 宿主绘制的主页组件。

notes_localizations.en: Kept CPU, memory, power, and network rows refreshing together while the Hardware view is open.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 进入硬件视图后，CPU、内存、电源与网络数据保持同一轮持续刷新。

notes_localizations.en: Refined native system, storage, network, battery, and process information.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 优化原生系统、存储、网络、电池与进程信息展示。

plugins.name: Unsplash
plugins.description: Search Unsplash photos, download, and set desktop wallpaper. Ported for Qx (Access Key API; likes/OAuth not included).

descriptions.en: Search Unsplash photos, download, and set desktop wallpaper.
descriptions.zh-CN: 搜索 Unsplash 图片，下载并设置桌面壁纸。

plugins.author: qx (ported from Raycast unsplash)

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate search-opening command while retaining real photo and wallpaper operations.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的搜索打开命令，同时保留真实的照片与壁纸操作。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the native media Workbench for photo search, downloads, clipboard, and wallpaper actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入原生媒体 Workbench，统一照片搜索、下载、剪贴板与壁纸操作。

plugins.name: V2EX
plugins.description: Browse V2EX latest, hot, and node topics with Workbench list/detail, replies, and cached host APIs.

descriptions.en: Browse V2EX latest, hot, and node topics with Workbench list/detail, replies, and cached host APIs.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 Workbench 列表/详情浏览 V2EX 最新、热门与节点主题，支持回复与宿主缓存接口。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed panel-opening and tab-navigation commands; notification and token commands still return real output.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除面板打开与标签切换命令，通知和令牌命令继续返回真实结果。

notes_localizations.en: Mark Open in Browser as the primary detail action so Enter opens the topic after reading.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将「在浏览器中打开」标为详情态 primary，阅读后回车即可打开原文。

notes_localizations.en: Rebuilt on host Workbench: Latest/Hot/Nodes/Notifications tabs, structured detail + replies, open/copy actions, and shared host cache. Built-in V2EX panel removed from Qx.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 全面接入宿主 Workbench：最新/热门/节点/通知标签、结构化详情与回复、打开/复制等 Action，并共用宿主缓存。Qx 已移除内置 V2EX 面板。

notes_localizations.en: Improved cached topic browsing, structured details, nodes, replies, and notification support.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进主题缓存浏览、结构化详情、节点、回复与通知支持。

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Current conditions and multi-day forecast via Open-Meteo (or OpenWeatherMap). Cached for fast reopen.

descriptions.en: Current conditions and multi-day forecast via Open-Meteo or OpenWeatherMap.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 Open-Meteo 或 OpenWeatherMap 查看当前天气和多日预报。

plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Removed the duplicate panel-opening command; the refresh command remains available for real weather output.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 移除重复的面板打开命令，刷新命令继续提供真实天气结果。

notes_localizations.en: Initial weather release with cached current conditions and multi-day forecasts.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个天气版本，支持当前天气与多日预报缓存。
